name: Darin R. Yates
prior_offices: Goshen County coroner (the official coroner page lists him in that office, with Steve Rostad as deputy coroner; he won the 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Darin R. Yates is the Goshen County coroner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official coroner page lists him in that office and names Steve Rostad as deputy coroner. County salary publications (used here for job titles only) list him as county coroner.
